if.test: chatbotVO != null and chatbotVO.searchWord != null and chatbotVO.searchWord != ''

where.if: AND (u.u_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{chatbotVO.searchWord}, '%') OR u.u_email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{chatbotVO.searchWord}, '%'))

if.test: chatbotVO != null and chatbotVO.dateFrom != null and chatbotVO.dateFrom != ''
chatbotVO != null and chatbotVO.dateTo != null and chatbotVO.dateTo != ''

trim.if: SUM(CASE WHEN (c.c_response IS NULL OR c.c_response = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
SUM(CASE WHEN (c.c_response IS NULL OR c.c_response = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0

mapper.select: SELECT c.c_session AS chat_session, u.u_idx AS user_idx, u.u_name AS user_name, u.u_email AS user_email, u.u_role AS user_role, DATE_FORMAT(u.u_created, '%Y-%m-%d') AS user_created, COUNT(c.c_idx) AS msg_count, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(c.c_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_time, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(c.c_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS end_time, SUM(CASE WHEN (c.c_response IS NULL OR c.c_response = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unresolved_count FROM chatbot c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.u_idx = u.u_idx WHERE c.c_session = #{chatSession} GROUP BY c.c_session, u.u_idx, u.u_name, u.u_email, u.u_role, u.u_created

SELECT c.c_idx AS chat_idx, c.u_idx AS user_idx, c.c_session AS chat_session, c.c_message AS chat_message, c.c_response AS chat_response, c.c_intent AS chat_intent, c.c_page AS chat_page, DATE_FORMAT(c.c_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS chat_time FROM chatbot c WHERE c.c_session = #{chatSession} ORDER BY c.c_idx ASC
